risk_note: RV2, settlement order-appeal R12 (BR-FUND-22 申诉恢复 ①) plus the commission snapshot R12 makes up (BR-CALC-10; orchestrator rulings D10-1091, D10-1093, D10-1105, D10-1117, D10-1131, D10-1135, D10-1136; written back by couli #315, #316). New consumer settlement-order-appeal-restore registers one appeal_restore difference per VOID entry under the order key's lock; registering writes no order, no ledger entry, no audit. admin-recon-restore dispatches it into the existing R12. R12, also for platform restores, makes the missing snapshot on its own transaction when the order is attributed and PAID or later and has no commission_splits row: no published rule version, an unrecoverable paid time or an unreadable taobao scene refuse with restore_snapshot_unavailable and write nothing; a commission not reported or a version without the platform's rule restores and leaves the usual snapshot retry row. Depends on CT-24zzg (#3027), B1-03zk (#2958), B2-09gc (#2960), B2-09gf (#2996), B2-04zzr (#3037). Known gap per D10-1135: no regression case yet for a VOID order whose commission_version the sync moved to 1 without a snapshot; follow-up B2-09ge after this merges. Real PostgreSQL: 160/160 for the new directory with platform-restore, admin-recon-restore, risk/appeal-restore and notification/appeal-result-message. Test-machine full verify not run (AWS runners disabled, D10-555; CI is the full verification).
